Done! All three functions are implemented and exported:

- **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js: Constrains n to the range [min, max] using Math.min/max
- **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js: Converts byte count to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
- **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js: Converts text to URL-safe slug format—lowercase, trim, replace spaces with dashes, strip non-alphanumeric characters
